Author: PriestKos
Name: Aetherpath
Punchline: Prices every way to get where you're going - and tells you where your free and favored slots earn the most gil.
Description: Reads the game's own live teleport prices, then ranks every travel option to your destination: direct teleport, free destination, favored slots, Return, aetheryte tickets, estate teleports and walk-in legs. Includes a slot optimizer that shows what your free transfer and three favored destinations would be worth if you moved them. Recommends only - it never executes a teleport or changes your settings.

Author: PriestKos
Name: Babel14
Punchline: Two-way chat translation powered by an LLM.
Description: Translate incoming and outgoing chat between languages using an LLM API. Toggle with /babel.

Author: PriestKos
Name: Blackjack14
Punchline: Player-run blackjack on /random or /dice: you pick the moves, it rolls, plays the dealer and scores.
Description: Plays player-run blackjack with /random 10 in say range or by tell, or /dice 10 in party or alliance. You press Deal, Hit, Stand, Double or Split; it rolls the cards, reads the results from chat, draws the dealer to 17 and settles the round in units, posting the result to any mix of Echo, Say, Party, Alliance and Tell. Nothing rolls without a button press, and never more than once every 2 seconds.

Author: PriestKos
Name: Calc14
Punchline: A fast, pretty calculator for FFXIV.
Description: A snappy calculator with history, percentage and clear modes.

Author: PriestKos
Name: FF14 Mod Manager Bridge
Punchline: Lets the FF14 Mod Manager desktop app see your character and apply designs and mods.
Description: Companion to the FF14 Mod Manager Windows app. Answers over a local, current-user-only named pipe: who you are, which Penumbra collection is on you, and applies Glamourer designs or toggles Penumbra mods on request.

Author: PriestKos
Name: FrontlineAdvisor
Punchline: Who is winning, who to hit, who is about to matter.
Description: Reads who is leading a Frontline match, says which Grand Company to focus and which is about to become dangerous, and calls out every change of leader.

Author: PriestKos
Name: Gate Alert
Punchline: Yells at you the moment your GATE opens in the Gold Saucer.
Description: Watches the Gold Saucer Attendant's announcements and prints a loud chat line when a GATE you care about goes live. Pick one GATE, several, or every GATE in the saucer.

Author: PriestKos
Name: HuntAlerts
Punchline:
Notifies you when hunt trains are starting soon
Supports NA/EU/OCE/JP
Description:
Notifies you when hunt trains are starting soon
Supports NA/EU/OCE/JP

Private-use fork by PriestKos. Original plugin and idea by Asuna (https://projects.gamba.pro/Asuna/huntalerts) - do not use this fork, use https://puni.sh/api/repository/asuna instead.

Author: PriestKos
Name: KeyLock
Punchline: Moves movement off WASD and jump off Space on demand, and puts them back.
Description: One command rebinds the game's own movement keybinds to the arrow keys and clears the Space binding from Jump, so typing in chat can never move the character by accident. Running it again restores exactly the binds it replaced; the original keybinds are saved in the plugin configuration so a restore still works after the client restarts.

Author: PriestKos
Name: KeyboundAssist
Punchline: Fills the Keybound Brawler prompt for you; you press Enter.
Description: For research use only. Reads the enemy prompts in the Keybound Brawler duty and writes the shortest one into the activity's own text field, one character at a time, stopping as soon as the word is complete. It never sends a keystroke: the player presses Enter to submit each word, and typing pauses while the duty prohibits input. An optional setting, off by default, sends the finished word itself after a randomised delay.

Author: PriestKos
Name: Nameplate Offset
Punchline: Raise or lower the nameplate above a character's head.
Description:
Moves the in-world nameplate vertically by adjusting the game object's nameplate height multiplier.
Slider in yalms (1 yalm = 1 metre). Your own character, other players and NPCs/objects can be offset independently.

Author: PriestKos
Name: StripDeathroll14
Punchline: Strip Deathroll host helper: turn order, roll calls, wrong-roll alerts, lives and round history.
Description: Hosts Strip Deathroll at a venue. Choose Private (say) or Public (party/alliance), build the player list from your party or by name, and it reads everyone's /random or /dice from chat: opening rolls set the order, each player is called to roll the previous number, a 1, 69 or 666 wins the round, and the winner's pick loses one of three pieces. It alerts on a wrong number or an out-of-turn roll, keeps a round history, and posts your rules and ad texts. Lines are posted only when you press Post unless you turn on auto-post, never more than once every 2 seconds.

Author: PriestKos
Name: VenueLedger
Punchline: Every venue you know, on one clock.
Description: Keeps a ledger of FFXIV venues with the details you actually need at the door: location with a one-click Lifestream teleport command, website, Discord, opening and closing times in the venue's own timezone, and notes. Every venue's hours are converted into your own timezone so schedules across venues line up side by side, a live clock reads your system time and timezone, and the whole ledger can be copied or exported to a file.

Author: PriestKos
Name: Wardrobe14
Punchline: A cross-collection view of your Penumbra mods; bulk toggles and Glamourer looks to follow.
Description: Shows every Penumbra mod against your own collection and any others you pin, with search and folder filters. Early build: it only reads from Penumbra. Bulk toggles, mod sets, undo and one-click Glamourer looks are planned.

Author: PriestKos
Name: WorldClock14
Punchline: One time, every timezone, one click to chat.
Description: Convert a time into every timezone you care about and copy the result straight into chat.
